hooks.command: p="${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}${TOOL_INPUT_file_path:-}"; case "$p" in */specs/*|*skills/ods/references*) echo '[.agents] Spec/skill refs edited — run: ods lint (and --okf/--skills if those trees changed); sync skills/ods/references if ODS keys changed' ;; */src/ods-core/src/spec/*) echo '[.agents] Schema registry edited — update specs/*/keys.md + tests; run cargo test -p ods-core --lib spec::schema' ;; */src/ods-*/*|*/src/scripts/*) echo '[.agents] Engine/scripts edited — before handoff: SKIP_RELEASE_BUILD=true ./src/scripts/check-local.sh && ODS_COVERAGE_FAIL_UNDER_LINES=90 ./src/scripts/coverage.sh' ;; */src/scripts/install.*) echo '[.agents] Install script is source of truth — sync app-web/public and skills/ods/scripts copies' ;; esac
